title: QIK-VRT Binding / Acceptance Safety Invariant v1
description: Canonical fail-closed safety invariant separating syntax, exact artifact byte binding, effect evidence, and Acceptance. Includes BCP 14 normative language, RFC 5234/RFC 7405 ABNF guidance, four validator result classes, and mandatory negative conformance classes. Hash equality alone MUST NOT open the Acceptance gate.
